'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Nick Jones DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Nick Jones]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Transcription note: the objective is written in Additional Cards #1; reserve lines 53, 55 and 56 are struck and Additional Cards #2–3 replace them

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?]]
* '''Username:''' The Quick
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
